name: Tortang Tuna
imageCredit: Photo: Judgefloro, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Drain the tuna and flake it with a fork.
Beat the eggs, then mix in the tuna, minced garlic, and chopped onion.
Heat oil in a pan and pour in half the mixture to form a patty.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden. Repeat with the rest.

name: Ginisang Monggo
imageCredit: Photo: Pandakekok9, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Boil the monggo in 6 cups of water for 30 to 40 minutes until soft.
In another pot, saute garlic, onion, and tomato in oil.
Add the cooked monggo with its water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the malunggay leaves, season with salt, and serve.

name: Ginisang Sardinas with Egg
imageCredit: Photo: ProjectManhattan, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute garlic and onion in oil until soft.
Add the sardines with the sauce and break them up lightly.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until the eggs are set.
Serve hot with rice.

name: Tokwa't Itlog
imageCredit: Photo: Choo Yut Shing, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Cook the rice. Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then peel and slice.
Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in oil until golden on all sides.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, and chopped onion to make the sawsawan.
Serve the tofu and eggs over rice with the sawsawan on top.

name: Chicken Breast Adobo
imageCredit: Photo: dbgg1979, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Cut the chicken breast into chunks.
Saute the garlic in oil, then add the chicken and brown it lightly.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper, and half a cup of water.
Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until the sauce thickens.

name: Chicken Tinola
imageCredit: Photo: Obsidian Soul, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute ginger, garlic, and onion in oil.
Add the chicken and cook until it is no longer pink.
Pour in 5 cups of water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the papaya and cook for 5 minutes, then add malunggay and serve.

name: Arroz Caldo
imageCredit: Photo: Wide Awake!, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute ginger, garlic, and onion in oil, then add the chicken.
Add the rinsed rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in 8 cups of water and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Hard-boil the eggs, then serve one on top of each bowl.

name: Ginisang Okra with Egg
imageCredit: Photo: Raymund Macaalay, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Slice the okra into rounds.
Saute garlic, onion, and tomato in oil until soft.
Add the okra and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir until set. Season with salt.
